name: Crown Zellerbach Building
note: One Bush Plaza (SOM 1959): green glass slab on pilotis and its dark tile service tower toward Market (own geometry on the footprint's axes). From Commons photographs.

name: Bush Plaza Pavilion
note: The round glass pavilion with the copper folded-plate roof (SVB Experience Center; OSM name 'svb', 532 Market). Own geometry, from artandarchitecture-sf.com's photograph.

name: Southern Pacific Building
note: One Market (Bliss & Faville 1916): cream arched base, red brick shaft, cream colonnade and deep cornice. Tower grammar from Commons photographs.

name: Postal Telegraph Building
note: 22 Battery on the Mechanics Monument plaza (Lewis Hobart 1908): brown brick, arcaded top storeys. Tower grammar from Commons photographs.

name: Hyatt Regency San Francisco
note: Portman 1973: the two room slabs, the atrium roof stepping down to the plaza, the service tower with the Equinox restaurant's square frames. Own geometry clipped from the footprint; the parts (the steps) replaced by it. From Commons photographs.

name: Matson Building
note: 215 Market (Bliss & Faville 1924): cream terracotta, columned base, arched top storey, lantern. Tower grammar from Commons photographs.

name: PG&E General Office Building
note: 245 Market (Bakewell & Brown 1925): grey terracotta, arcaded base, top four storeys stepped back. Tower grammar from Commons photographs and Wikipedia.

name: PG&E General Office Building Annex
note: The 1945 annex on Beale, matching the General Office Building. OSM's 83 m is the main building's; 13 storeys is about 52 m.

name: 333 Market
note: 1979: bronze glass between beige piers, stepped corners. Tower grammar from Commons photographs.

name: 388 Market
note: SOM 1987: red granite and glass ribbons round a flatiron with a cylindrical prow. Tower grammar from Commons photographs.

name: 425 Market
note: SOM 1973: white aluminium grid, blank plant storeys on top. Tower grammar from Commons photographs.

name: First Market Tower
note: 525 Market (1973): fine cream mullions. Tower grammar from Commons photographs.

name: 555 Market Street
note: SOM 1964: plain grey concrete grid. Tower grammar from Commons photographs.

name: Chevron Tower
note: 575 Market (1975): the taller twin of 555's grid. Tower grammar from Commons photographs.

name: One Front Street
note: SOM 1979: white bands and dark glass, the Market corner cut into steps (the notched footprint). Tower grammar from Commons photographs.

name: One Sansome Street
note: Citicorp Center tower (1984): pale granite, teal ribbon windows, chamfered corners. Modelled on the tower part; the old bank hall beside it is its own entry.

name: 44 Montgomery Street
note: 1967: dark glass behind close white fins. Tower grammar from Commons photographs.

name: Flatiron Building (544 Market)
note: Havens & Toepke 1913: the small cream wedge at Market, Sutter and Sansome. Tower grammar.

name: Hobart Building
note: Willis Polk 1914: the block on Market and the slender arcaded tower with the oval prow and tiled cap over its Montgomery end. Own geometry on the footprint plus the tower grammar.
